session_note: The 114th Tennessee General Assembly's 2026 session (second year of the 2025-2026 biennium) completed its final floor votes in the last week of April 2026 and the capitol.tn.gov homepage now states the 114th General Assembly 'has adjourned sine die' with the 115th General Assembly convening 2027-01-12; a secondary source (Wikipedia) gives 2026-04-23 as the adjournment date, consistent with enrolled bills continuing to be signed by the Governor into May 2026. This is the terminal year of the biennium: any bill not enacted by sine die is dead with no further carryover.
